mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_notification_setting (account_id, deadline_reminder_enabled, deadline_reminder_days_before, deadline_reminder_email, deadline_reminder_push, email_consented_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{enabled}, #{daysBefore}, #{email}, #{push}, CASE WHEN #{email} THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE email_consented_at = CASE WHEN #{email} THEN COALESCE(email_consented_at, #{now}) ELSE NULL END, deadline_reminder_enabled = #{enabled}, deadline_reminder_days_before = #{daysBefore}, deadline_reminder_email = #{email}, deadline_reminder_push = #{push}, updated_at = #{now}
